t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are four pairs of gnomes and you need to identify which is the best performing. If one starts to underperform then you should swap to the other gnome in the pair.

vb_textbox.text: You will see four pairs of gnomes. The pairs will swap back and forth. You need to figure out which of each pair is the better performing at mushroom collecting. If your choice stops performing well, swap to the other one in the pair. Which one in each pair is performing best will change in each round.
